target_title: Release 2.3.10 to the PPA — clipboard fix + re-transcribe + accumulated main
note: All five acceptance criteria verified against the live system: Cargo.toml and debian/changelog both read 2.3.10, tag v2.3.10 exists, Launchpad getPublishedBinaries reports both noble and jammy1 Published at 2026-07-17T14:11:48Z, and apt-cache policy shows 2.3.10 installed and candidate from the PPA.

target_title: Fill 2.3.10 available_utc once Launchpad binary publishes
note: Launchpad getPublishedBinaries now returns both 2.3.10 rows as Published at 2026-07-17T14:11:48Z, so the pending available_utc and deploy_to_available columns in packaging/linux/ppa-release-times.tsv are filled with measured values of 4h02m37s for noble and 4h01m23s for jammy.

target_title: Fix hotkey release lost during typing wait
note: Root cause traced to the key-down handler blocking the X11 event thread so the genuine KeyRelease arrived at ~0ms and was discarded by the 150ms guard; the regression is covered by a test proven to fail against the old logic and pass against the fix, the full suite is green at 127 passed, and a live 39ms tap now stops the recording where the old build would have stranded the microphone.

target_title: Track PPA build durations — record upload→build-start wait and build time per release
note: scripts/record-ppa-times.sh reads getBuildRecords and getPublishedBinaries and writes packaging/linux/ppa-build-times.tsv, release-ppa.sh calls it after upload, and four releases are backfilled showing that build time is 2-19 minutes while Launchpad's post-build publisher cycle ranges from 17 minutes to 3h54m; the promotion-to-feature criterion is deferred to the operator as it asks for their judgement.
